name: career-consultancy
description: Career Consultancy consultancy website: React + Tailwind CSS, pre-rendered for SEO.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:staging: vite build --mode staging && vite build --mode staging --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs --staging
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run seo:check
